name: Average annual price changes in private health insurance premiums, 1997-2026
source: Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing - 'Average annual price changes in private health insurance premiums', industry average row.
transformation: Industry average row read from the published .xlsx. The sheet stores some cells as percentage points and others as decimal fractions; any value below 0.5 was multiplied by 100. Changes take effect 1 April each year.
note: Every one of the last ten years has run above the RBA's 2.5% inflation midpoint. This is why the build plan asks for private health insurance to be a separate spending line with its own index rather than folded into CPI-indexed baseline spending.
